Hi Marissa / Alice —

Thanks for the heads up, Marissa — happy to provide the details. Short answers below; happy to jump on a 20–30m call if you want to walk through.

SOC 2
- Status: SOC 2 Type II (security & availability) — most recent period ended Oct 31, 2025.
- What we can share: Attached is the SOC 2 summary (Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf). The full SOC 2 Type II report is available for review under an NDA (we typically provide via DocuSign + restricted Drive link).

Pen test / Vulnerability management
- Last third-party pen test: Nov 2025, vendor: SecLabs (independent pen test). High-level report (executive summary) can be shared immediately; full technical appendices are shared under NDA.
- Attachments: Redwood_PenTest_Report_2025.pdf (executive summary). Full report available after NDA.

Scanning cadence & ownership
- Authenticated internal scans: weekly (internal security + automated scanner).
- External/black-box scans: monthly external scans + ad-hoc scans surrounding major deployments and releases.
- Continuous monitoring: we run SCA and infra monitoring for anomalous activity; critical alerts route to on-call secops.

Vulnerability disclosure & SLAs
- Initial triage & acknowledgment: 72 hours for critical/confirmed vulnerabilities.
- Target remediation windows: critical (P0/P1) — mitigated or mitigations in place within 30 days depending on risk and customer impact; we coordinate status updates with impacted customers.
- Coordinated disclosure: we prefer coordinated disclosure. If a third party discloses, we follow our policy (public disclosure only after coordinated remediation or 90 days if no coordination).

Sharing process
- If FinTechCo is OK, we’ll route a standard mutual NDA via DocuSign (link below). Once signed we’ll provide the full SOC 2 report and the full pen test technical appendices via a restricted Drive folder.

Links / Next steps
- DocuSign NDA (standard mutual): https://docusign.com/envelope/example-ndax123
- Secure drive folder (post-NDA): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/redwood-security-artifacts

Marissa — I’m happy to join the call if Alice’s team wants to run through the questionnaire or the SLA language. If you want, I can draft the short Q&A bullet list for Alice and return it within the hour.

Thanks,
